faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about pricing and plans

afterBeta.question: What happens after the beta period?
afterBeta.answer: Beta users will be offered special pricing and the option to lock in their rate before we officially launch. You'll have plenty of notice before any billing begins.

userPricing.question: How does the user pricing work?
userPricing.answer: Your first 5 users are £49 per user per month. Users 6+ are £39 per user per month. You only pay for active users, and you can add or remove users at any time.

tryBeforeBuy.question: Can I try before I buy?
tryBeforeBuy.answer: Join our beta for free access, or start a 14-day free trial of the Professional plan. No credit card required for beta access.

paymentMethods.question: What payment methods do you accept?
paymentMethods.answer: We accept all major credit and debit cards. Annual billing options are available with a discount. Contact us for invoicing or alternative payment arrangements.

setupFee.question: Is there a setup fee or contract?
setupFee.answer: No setup fees, no hidden costs, and no long-term contracts. Pay monthly and cancel anytime. We believe in earning your business every month.

annualBilling.question: Do you offer discounts for annual billing?
annualBilling.answer: Yes! Annual billing saves you 2 months (equivalent to 16% off). Contact our sales team for custom enterprise pricing for studios with 20+ users.
